title: Turing College wins the German Education Award for AI training
summary: Turing College won the Deutscher Bildungs-Award 2026/2027 for AI training. See how 28,360 customer ratings were scored and where we came first.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


-


**Winner in AI training:** Turing College is one of two winners in the AI training category ("Weiterbildung/Trainings zu KI") of the Deutscher Bildungs-Award 2026/2027. WBS Coding School is the other. DISQ created the category this year, and it's our first DISQ award.


-


**Decided by customers:** The award is based on 28,360 customer ratings of 392 education providers, collected by the German Institute for Service Quality (DISQ) for the news channel ntv. There's no jury.


-


**First of five in the category:** Five AI training providers got enough ratings to be scored. Turing College scored 78.7 out of 100, against a category average of 76.6.


-


**Highest score for customer service:** We scored 82.3 for customer service, the top result in the category.


-


**Second year in Germany:** We started teaching funded learners in Germany in May 2025. The groups behind IU Akademie and WBS Coding School have been in German education for decades.


Turing College has won the Deutscher Bildungs-Award 2026/2027 for AI training.[DISQ](https://disq.de/bildung-award.html) and[ntv](https://www.n-tv.de/ratgeber/Der-Deutsche-Bildungs-Award-2026-2027-geht-an-id31542239.html) published the results on 18 November 2026. It's our first DISQ award, in a category DISQ created this year. The award is based on what customers said, and our learners rated us highest of the five AI training providers that were scored.


## How the Deutscher Bildungs-Award is decided


The award is decided by a customer survey. Between 26 May and 20 July 2026, DISQ collected 28,360 ratings of 392 education providers across 49 categories. The people surveyed were adults who knew the provider, for example as a customer in the past 12 months. Each provider's result is based on up to 100 customer ratings. Only providers with enough ratings got their own result.


DISQ says it doesn't run studies on behalf of companies. So the only way to do well is for your learners to rate you well.

We scored above the category average in all four areas.


We started teaching funded learners in Germany in May 2025, so this is our second year here. The groups behind IU Akademie and WBS Coding School have been in German education for decades. Our learners rated us ahead of both overall and on customer service. For a team this new to the German market, that's the result I'm proudest of.


## Why customer service is the score I care about most


Customer service is where we scored highest, and I think it tells a future learner the most. DISQ measured how easy it is to reach someone and how competent and friendly the answers are. That sounds like a small thing. In online learning it often decides whether people finish.


I suspect the most common reason people drop out of an online programme is that they get stuck and nobody helps them in time. A learner who waits three days for an answer to a simple question often doesn't come back.


## What the award means if you're choosing a funded programme in Germany


If you're choosing a funded programme in Germany, a large customer survey is one of the few outside signals you can check. Many of our learners in Germany study with a[Bildungsgutschein](https://www.turingcollege.com/bildungsgutschein) . The voucher is issued by the[Agentur für Arbeit or Jobcenter](https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/karriere-und-weiterbildung/foerderung-berufliche-weiterbildung) and can cover the cost of an approved programme. At Turing College, individual funded learners can join[AI Engineering](https://www.turingcollege.com/ai-engineering) or[Building with AI Agents](https://www.turingcollege.com/building-with-ai) .


For a funded learner, the real cost is time. Months spent on the wrong programme are hard to get back. Most programme pages make the same promises, so outside evidence helps. It's the same reason we publish our[job placement rates for Bildungsgutschein learners](https://www.turingcollege.com/blog/bildungsgutschein-job-placement-rates-2026) .


If you're comparing AI programmes, ask every provider, including us, what happens when you get stuck in week three. The answer will tell you more than the syllabus.


Thank you to every learner who took the time to fill in the survey, and to our[education team](https://www.turingcollege.com/team) and everyone else who answers learners' questions every day.


## Frequently asked questions


What is the Deutscher Bildungs-Award?


It's a German award for education providers, based on a customer survey by the German Institute for Service Quality (DISQ) for the news channel ntv. The 2026/2027 edition covers 49 categories, from tutoring and language schools to professional training and private universities.


Who won the AI training category?


Turing College and WBS Coding School. DISQ lists the winners in each category in alphabetical order.


Which providers were scored in the AI training category?


Five providers got enough customer ratings to be scored: D-School, IU Akademie, KI-Campus, Turing College and WBS Coding School.


What does a score of 78.7 mean?


It's a weighted average of four areas on a scale of 0 to 100: price-value (40%), offer (30%), customer service (20%) and recommendation (10%). The AI training category averaged 76.6. Across all 49 categories, the best category average was 78.4.


Can I study at Turing College with a Bildungsgutschein?


Yes, if you're eligible. Individual learners in Germany can use a Bildungsgutschein for AI Engineering or Building with AI Agents. The Agentur für Arbeit or your Jobcenter decides whether you get a voucher. See our[Bildungsgutschein page](https://www.turingcollege.com/bildungsgutschein) for how it works.
